newsitem.title: UK: AIG assigned A1+, AAA ratings by IBCA.
newsitem.headline: AIG assigned A1+, AAA ratings by IBCA.

text.p: IBCA has assigned an A1+ short term and AAA long term rating to insurer American International Group Inc (AIG) and its indirect, majority-owned subsidiary AIG International Inc.
The rating of AIG reflected the strong earnings record of the group's core insurance operations, together with accurate reserving and strong capitalisation, IBCA said in a statement.
"In IBCA's opinion, the group's dynamic and experienced management team represents a particular strength," it added.
AIG is the holding company of one of the world's largest insurance and financial services groups.
